Not A PUB at all - not much of anything
Oct 2019
A takeaway burger joint is what this is.

There's very little space to sit inside. And the two guys behind the counter are probably going to be far too busy most of the time filling food orders to deal with serving anyone drinks. And the selection is VERY limited anyway: only Tiger on draft (Tiger?! WHY???), and a couple of other brands in bottle.

When I looked in last week, they were too busy even to acknowledge my presence. I guess they'd just had a phone-in order, but... it wasn't like they were completely overwhelmed. I waited very patiently, made a few discreet efforts to establish eye contact, initiate a conversation - COMPLETELY IGNORED every time! After about five minutes, I gave up and left. I don't think they noticed that I'd gone; they might not even have noticed that I was there in the first place.

The burgers they were making looked quite tasty, I have to say. But if they can't get their basic customer service sorted out, they don't deserve your business.

Jun 2019 • Solo
